## Description

New page /assist: "Spend the visit with your patient, not the keyboard.", how it works step by step, the sample visit note with the interaction warning (synthetic cast), "Safety first: built so a doctor is always in charge" (AI does not diagnose, prescribe or sign; every suggestion is labelled, linked to what was said and needs approval), and the add-on line. CTAs: start free trial, see a live demo.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the page, when it renders, then it states that nothing is saved until the doctor signs and makes no diagnostic or accuracy claim.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given JavaScript is off, when the page loads, then it renders fully; axe is clean in en, hi and ar; Arabic is right to left.
- [ ] **AC3.** The add-on price shows only from the approved plan list; without it the line shows no price.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
